features.name: Automatic JSON backup side effect
features.implementation: Unsafe stale public automatic files are not copied; explicit ACL-filtered export plus parent durable Store.

features.name: Category data/localization
features.implementation: 13 English/Dutch packaged categories; non-BE fallback uses the actual English set.

features.name: Category emergency fallback
features.implementation: Bundled datasets are hash-checked in tests; missing or malformed package data raises rather than inventing categories.

features.name: Catalog model materialization
features.implementation: Preserve dataset currency, metadata and explicit zero; namespace product IDs by region.

features.name: Packaged catalog loading/failure policy
features.implementation: Load only allowlisted package-local catalogs; custom regions have no synthetic catalog.

features.name: Declared unit and quantity vocabularies
features.implementation: Preserve real declared unit/default-quantity values; UI metric preference does not convert quantities or impose fabricated units.

features.name: Six complete regional catalog datasets
features.implementation: Six complete catalogs: five times 172, Belgium 62.

features.name: Region and boolean configuration
features.implementation: All three booleans and current country persist in staged shared kitchen; price visibility/metric display remain UI preferences, not deletion.

features.name: UI-only single-instance config entry
features.implementation: Unified integration owns config-entry lifecycle; shopping reads default to NZ without a hidden write.

features.name: Six HA bus events
features.implementation: Parent publishes generic ACL-filtered refresh after durable save; domain supplies private event audience for removals.

features.name: Frontend absent from pinned backend
features.implementation: No frontend existed in pinned backend; unified card is outside this pure-domain module.

features.name: Image target constants
features.implementation: Parent normalizes private media; no unbounded downloads or public-file paths in domain.

features.name: Local available image enumeration
features.implementation: Unregistered local image enumeration is not represented as a working command; authenticated media belongs to parent.

features.name: Local/external image helper
features.implementation: Original setup helper was never called by registered commands. Preserve explicit image metadata; do not fake automatic search or placeholder data.

features.name: Legacy image directory and URL migration
features.implementation: No filesystem migration is performed by pure shopping; legacy local media must be explicitly migrated by the parent if imported.

features.name: Entry options reload / globals
features.implementation: Parent integration lifecycle only; pure state is JSON-serializable and settings/overrides survive roundtrip.

features.name: UUID / UTC / serialisation
features.implementation: Stable UUID records and caller-supplied UTC timestamps; copied JSON responses.

features.name: Per-item estimated total
features.implementation: Known unit-price times quantity only; null price clears estimate; currency breakdown for mixtures.

features.name: Rich product metadata
features.implementation: All rich fields editable for custom products and current-user catalog overrides; no fabricated nutrition.

features.name: Custom region format migration
features.implementation: Upstream legacy Store string-wrapper migration belongs to administrative migration, not hidden read-time mutation.

features.name: Search engine lifecycle
features.implementation: Query derived current permitted data; no stale global mutable index.

features.name: Fuzzy ranking weights
features.implementation: Tested Unicode casefold/stdlib fuzzy name and alias ranking; not a claim of bit-identical RapidFuzz scores.

features.name: Taxonomy filters / threshold helper
features.implementation: Taxonomy filtering is explicitly exposed instead of dormant helper-only metadata.

features.name: Product frequency/last-used metadata
features.implementation: Authenticated-user frequency/last-used survives country changes and is never shared as another user's usage.

features.name: Startup restore/default global list
features.implementation: Default NZ catalog and packaged categories are immutable read projections; no persistent list is created by a read.

features.name: Six independently saved HA Stores
features.implementation: One staged kitchen, no Store or file writes; parent lock/ledger/durable save owns transactions.

features.name: Supermarket and store options
features.implementation: Brands and store-card metadata preserved, not live retailer pricing or stock.

features.name: HA todo entity link metadata
features.implementation: Nullable ha_todo_entity_id metadata preserved; upstream never implemented synchronization.
